title: Voice Chat
description: We're excited to introduce our brand-new Voice Chat feature, giving users a faster, more natural way to get the answers they need. They can simply ask their question out loud and listen to the bot's response here and now. It's quick, convenient, and adds a whole new layer of ease to their ChatOn experience. Creating the best experience for our users earned us the Silver Lovie Award and the People's Lovie Award. This only proves that whether it's drafting emails, polishing resumes, planning trips, solving math issues, or beyond, ChatOn keeps things simple, quick, and stress-free.
